content.text:
The site looked different because the web font wasn't loading. I fixed it, and all 12 visual tests and all 16 functional tests now pass.

In `site/css/tokens.css`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`. The actual directory is `site/fonts/`. The font file returned a 404, so every page fell back to the system font, and that changed text widths and layout everywhere.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. Nothing else was touched.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the wrong path. I haven't committed the fix.

STATUS: DONE
